title: Chiliz Metaplex
tagline: Chiliz Metaplex: Bringing Virtual Sports Events, Meet players with AI DigiAvatar, Online Social Events, and NFT Collectibles
description:
Chiliz Metaplex takes sports fandom to new heights by transforming live events and experiences into a fully immersive, virtual space. It's more than an app—it's an all-encompassing experience where sports enthusiasts can engage with the games they love and connect with like-minded fans from around the world.

Our metaverse features:

    Live Social Events: Watch live sports matches with friends or meet new people in virtual lounges.
    Virtual Experience: Enter a spatial cricket experience where you can watch matches, view player stats in real-time, and experience the game like never before, all through VR.
    Virtual Stadium Tours: Explore a digital replica of a cricket stadium and meet AI avatars of cricket legends, like Sachin Tendulkar, who will interact with you in real-time.
    NFT Museum: Discover rare NFTs and historic memorabilia in a virtual museum and marketplace built on the Chiliz blockchain.
    Cricket History Museum: Get a guided tour from an AI assistant through the rich history of cricket.
    Digi Avatars: Fulfill your dream of meeting your sports heroes—interact with AI-powered avatars of your favorite players and ask them questions just like they're right there beside you.

Chiliz Integrations:

    Dream11-Inspired Cricket Platform: Fantasy cricket built on the Chiliz network, where you can use Chiliz tokens to compete, trade, and collect.
    Player Card Marketplace: Purchase and trade digital player cards of your favorite athletes on the Chiliz Player Card Marketplace.
how_its_made: We integrated cutting-edge technology to craft a fully immersive sports experience. AR-VR capabilities (using Unreal Engine) deliver a spatial experience for virtual tours and live matches. The Chiliz Spicy Network powers our fantasy cricket platform, NFT marketplace, and player card trading system. Integration with Thirdweb ensures seamless blockchain interactions, while Next.js supports the web infrastructure for high-performance applications. Together, these technologies bring a dynamic and interactive sports metaverse to life, reshaping how fans engage with their favorite games.
